from manim import *

class ConfidenceIntervalCoverage(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Confidence intervals vary; the population mean does not", font_size=34).to_edge(UP)
        line = NumberLine(x_range=[45, 55, 1], length=8, include_numbers=True).shift(UP * 1.5)
        true_x = line.n2p(50)[0]
        mean_line = DashedLine(
            np.array([true_x, 2.1, 0]),
            np.array([true_x, -2.0, 0]),
            color=YELLOW,
        )
        mean_label = Text("fixed mean", font_size=24, color=YELLOW).next_to(mean_line, UP, buff=0.1)
        specs = [(47.5, 51.5), (49.0, 52.5), (46.5, 49.5), (48.0, 50.8), (50.2, 54.0)]
        intervals = VGroup()
        for index, (low, high) in enumerate(specs):
            y_shift = DOWN * (0.75 + index * 0.50)
            contains = low <= 50 <= high
            color = GREEN if contains else RED
            segment = Line(line.n2p(low) + y_shift, line.n2p(high) + y_shift, color=color, stroke_width=7)
            caps = VGroup(
                Line(segment.get_start() + DOWN * 0.1, segment.get_start() + UP * 0.1, color=color),
                Line(segment.get_end() + DOWN * 0.1, segment.get_end() + UP * 0.1, color=color),
            )
            label = Text(f"sample {index + 1}", font_size=18).next_to(segment, LEFT, buff=0.25)
            intervals.add(VGroup(segment, caps, label))
        legend = VGroup(
            Text("contains mean", font_size=20, color=GREEN),
            Text("misses mean", font_size=20, color=RED),
        ).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.8).to_edge(DOWN)
        takeaway = Text(
            "Coverage describes repeated use—not a probability for this fixed mean.",
            font_size=24,
        ).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(Write(title), Create(line), Create(mean_line), FadeIn(mean_label))
        self.play(LaggedStart(*[Create(interval) for interval in intervals], lag_ratio=0.35), run_time=4)
        self.play(FadeIn(legend))
        self.wait(1)
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(legend, takeaway))
        self.play(Indicate(mean_label, color=YELLOW))
        self.wait(2)
